svg.title: Worker process connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for Worker process.

a.xlink:title: App lifecycle worker. Owns install, repair, media import, backup, restore preview, update readiness/apply, and removal paths only where implemented and safe.
Backup and verification engine. Creates and verifies local encrypted backups through backend/worker-owned operations.
Command admission and lifecycle. Tracks admission, queued, claimed, running, terminal, acknowledgement, retry, and dead-letter behavior independently from device lifecycle.
NATS / JetStream. Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.
Worker process. Consumes durable commands and owns backend execution for apps, security, recovery, releases, and lifecycle work.
